name: Wild Armor
body:
Shapeshifters may wear wild armor. For shapeshifters, wild armor works just like it does for a druid using wild shape. Whenever a shapeshifter equipped with wild armor is using his Shapechange, Form of the Mythical Beast, Form of the Dragon or Giant Form abilities, he gets the armor class benefits provided by the armor
